# Hero cameras and lighting (owner brief 2026-11-02 07:29Z, Thread 4 / P4)

Presentation only: no geometry, parameter canon or physical budget changes, except the ship-name marking orientation (a detail-pack
lettering fix, `spine_casing`). Builds on the exterior-production set (`hero_cameras.py`, `[look.hero_cameras]`,
`presentation/hero_set.py`): the same three cameras, refined; no second camera system.

## Function

Three permanent exterior compositions that read the ship's systems at a glance (Engineering, Forward Explorer, Propulsion/First
Ignition), each with a reproducible physical-reference render and an explicitly labelled cinematic variant.

## Fixed constraints

- Physical reference = one hard sun ([look.exterior] calibration), black space, matched exposure; it stays renderable unchanged.
- Editorial light is a presentation option, named `EDITORIAL_*`, never a ship light and never in the physical variant.
- First Ignition emission follows the established grey-body model (look.grey_body_luminance, kelvin_rgb, radiators.temperature 1800 K,
  emissivity 0.90; startup 1332 K from references/evidence/first_ignition_render.json). No temperature gradient: the hot loop's
  inlet/outlet split is not sourced (no key in data/), so none is drawn.
- check(): nearest ship part >= 0.25 x ship length; cameras follow the ship's stations, so other threads' geometry rerenders as is.

## Diagnosis of the current set (exterior_production_2026-11-01 heroes)

| Issue | Cause | Plan |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Rings hard to recognise | Rings (r 30 m, X 97/103) sit between the Brow (r 45 m, X 142-145) and the LOW blades; FORWARD looks 13 deg off broadside, so they are 6.7 m-wide edge-on slivers | Swing FORWARD to ~25-28 deg forward of broadside: ring ellipse about 2x wider and still clear of the Brow's projected disk (needs tan(theta) > ~1.9 from the axis) |
| EYE wells unreadable | Brow face nearly edge-on to camera and sun | More frontal Brow view in FORWARD, sun raking the face from the camera side |
| Recesses in darkness | single sun, zero ambient (correct physically) | cinematic variant: labelled editorial fill + rim; physical variant unchanged |
| Bulkhead dominates | ENGINEERING looks along the blade plane at the polished foil disk, sun on it | lower the bulkhead in frame weight (angle, sun azimuth) |
| First Ignition blades flat | Lambertian uniform emission at 4x sunlit-hull luminance, near clipping | exposure that keeps the hot face below clip; directional emissivity (dielectric coating, falls at grazing) and per-cell emissivity lot spread (isolatable cells, PROTOTYPE tolerance); startup 1332 K variant |
| Ship name inverted | spine_casing text reads aft (right = -X) on every bisector, so from the hero sides it is upside down or mirrored | per-bisector reading direction so the camera-facing names read left to right, letter tops dorsal |
| Black negative space | fit boxes use R (Brow radius) for every camera; 16:9 with a long thin ship | tighter fits, focus offsets, framing on the subject not the box |

## Unknowns

Attitude and sun direction (OPEN; per-shot presentation choices), hot-loop temperature split (OPEN), coating directional emissivity
(PROTOTYPE assumption, dielectric n ~1.5-2).
